title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Regulation and the Caribbean Context

questions.text: Why should users convert TT dollars to digital assets only through registered platforms that enforce KYC?
options: To avoid account freezes, fraud, and operational headaches.
To hide your transactions from your bank
questions.explanation: Using registered platforms with KYC reduces the risk of account freezes, fraud, and operational issues.

questions.text: True or false: Blockchain automatically calculates your local‑currency gain or loss for tax purposes.
questions.explanation: Blockchain records do not show local‑currency profit or loss; users must keep their own records.
